title: Liam Gallagher's Son Looks Like Father
htmlContent:
Lennon Gallagher and girlfriend Isobel Richmond looked edgy in black as they posed outside the Palm Angels womenswear fall/winter 2023-2024 show during Paris Fashion Week in France on Sunday.

Lennon looked almost just like his father, Liam Gallagher as his dark and brooding personality was on full display as he was with his girlfriend who really matched the vibe perfectly.

Many have spoken up about Oasis coming back together, but it just seems too far fetched to really get done. While Liam has not been totally for or against this (at least within the past few months) it's tough to say that any headway would get done at all.

This has struck a chord with fans and even the Gallagher brother's mother. Liam's mother has spoken candidly to her son about patching things up with Noel. Liam, has seemingly made efforts in the past, at least, via Twitter, but nothing really ever came of it.

All of that said, it does seem like the gripes that the duo have held towards one another are slowly starting to dwindle with age, so hopefully this is a very good sign.

For now, it seems like only the next generation of Gallaghers may be able to start something with the name, but regardless, at least the new generation doesn't seem to hold the same distaste for the family name as the former generation.
